title: Ohm Brew Ice Menthol 50/50 Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Ohm Brew’s Iced Menthol is for menthol lovers who crave a touch of sweetness. The invigorating menthol blast is tempered to wonderful effect by a subtle peppermint candy note that makes this a beautifully rounded, and refreshing, menthol vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
